lines.text: *Bang!*
A red flare shoots into the sky over our heads, leaving a faint trail of smoke in its wake.
It is a signal flare fired by Eunhwa.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: All set. We've sent our coordinates, so support should be here soon.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Of course, that means even the ones we'd rather keep in the dark now know where we are.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Ready to take down some Raptures?
Let's do this.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Good. Then I'm counting on you, Junior Blockhead.
But how are you so sure that support will come?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... At that time, some Nikkes from Elysion were carrying out an operation nearby.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: They found me shortly after I died.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: So, if this simulation is truly based on my memories,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: support will arrive before sunset, right after I died.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: If we can hold out until then, we'll be able to clear this simulation.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: So hurry up and finish your sniping prep.
Roger.
I get into position and start aiming.
*Thud*
Through the scope, I see the Raptures slowly approaching from afar.
*Thud thud*
Their footsteps grow louder, shaking the ground beneath me.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Just as I expected, the flare drew them in. All the Raptures in the area are converging here.
There are probably dozens of them.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Just so you know, they're coming not only from the front but from the sides too.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: In other words, we're surrounded.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: There's nowhere left to retreat, so if support doesn't arrive, we're as good as dead.
Feeling nervous?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Nervous? Who exactly do you think is nervous, Junior Blockhead?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: It's you who should be scared right now, isn't it?
I'm not that scared.
I trust you, after all.
Ah, your face is bright red.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Enough chatter... Just get ready to intercept!
Okay.
I press my eye back against the scope and focus.
The swarm of Raptures comes into view, much closer than before.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op
lines.text: ... We should choke off their route first.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op
lines.text: Junior Blockhead, see the crumbling bridge at 10 o'clock?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op
lines.text: Think you can hit its weak point?
Where exactly is that?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op
lines.text: That's where the concrete has broken off, revealing only the steel frame. Can you hit it?
Hmm... I think so.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op
lines.text: Good. Take out that section first and bring down the bridge to restrict the Raptures' assault route.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op
lines.text: Fire when ready.
I aim at the spot Eunhwa indicated.
The bridge is barely holding its shape, hanging on by a single steel beam.
I line up the upper-left of that exposed steel to the center of my scope and pull the trigger.
*Bang!*
*Creak*
The already weakened steel snaps under the bullet's impact.
*Craaash!*
Unable to bear its own weight, the bridge collapses.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: Nice shot, Junior Blockhead.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: Now just focus on what's ahead.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: All right, let's start the counterattack for real now.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: The first target is the foremost Rapture on the route.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: The second is any Rapture that breaks formation.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: If I detect any unusual movements, I'll notify you.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: You've got five seconds per target, more or less.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: If you don't take them down in time, they'll get close enough to fire upon us.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: You got all that?
Got it. I'm all set.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: All right, then.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: Commence firing.
*Bang!*
The muzzle spits fire in steady intervals.
With each shot, another Rapture falls motionless.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op
lines.text: You're doing well. Keep it up.
Roger that.
*Bang bang*
How long have I been fighting the endless horde of Raptures?
Before I know it, the sun is already slipping below the horizon.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op
lines.text: Two Raptures on the rooftop of the tilted building.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op
lines.text: Shoot the ground beneath and bring it down.
Got it.
*Bang*
*Rumble!*
The floor gives away, and the Raptures come tumbling down.
*Bang bang*
I quickly shoot the two Raptures that are immobilized by the impact of the fall.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op
lines.text: Good job. Now focus on the front again.
I turn the muzzle forward again.
So far, no Raptures have gotten close enough to open fire,
but their charge still shows no sign of stopping.
*Bang*
Ugh...
My body's getting worn down from absorbing the recoil.
My aim is slipping bit by bit, and my firing speed is gradually slowing.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op
lines.text: Keep going! Hold on just a little longer!
Whew...
I take a deep breath and aim again.
*Click*
*Bang!*
... Oh no!
I missed! I didn't hit the Rapture!
*Thud thud*
A Rapture is rapidly closing in on us,
and its target is...
Eunhwa!
*Screeeeee*
The Rapture's beam cannon is just about to fire in our direction.
Just then...
*Whoosh!*
A barrage of missiles screams in from somewhere.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: We won.
*Screeeech*
The Rapture targeting Eunhwa suddenly jerks and slows down.
*Boom*
*Boom boom*
Then, it takes a direct missile hit and explodes on the spot.
What...?
Not only that, the other approaching Raptures also slow down,
and are soon engulfed by the flames created by the incoming missiles, disappearing completely.
It must be Vesti and Emma...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: This is based on data from my NIMPH, right...?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Those two are the strongest support I can think of.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Simulation cleared.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Good job holding out until backup arrived, Junior Blockhead.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: It was tougher than I thought, but you handled it well.
I just followed your orders, Eunhwa.
If anything, I learned a lot from you.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Is that so?
But I've got a question.
How did Emma and Vesti, who weren't there back then, come as reinforcements?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Not sure. It's just a guess, but

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: since my NIMPH can't possibly contain any data from after my death,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: this simulation is probably a combination of two data sets: one where the Nikkes from Elysion arrived shortly after I died,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: and another representing reinforcements that could absolutely save me.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: They combined those two to create a kind of mission-clear reward within the simulation.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: The idea behind it is probably something like, "If you have this kind of support, you'll always survive."
... Um, Eunhwa,
do you happen to still have any regrets about what happened back then?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Regrets, huh...?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I always thought I had none. But maybe, deep down, I did.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Perhaps it was fear, too.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: If I'd had comrades I could truly rely on,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I wouldn't have met such a meaningless end.
I see...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: But this time, I'm certain of it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Now that I have comrades I can trust,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I won't let opportunities slip away so pointlessly like I did back then...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Ah...
Eunhwa stares straight at my face.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Comrades, huh...
Uh... Is there something on my face?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Tsk. Never mind. Don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Let's get out of here.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I'll treat you to a meal when we get back.
Oh, really?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Yeah. There's a place I often go to with Emma and Vesti.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: It's not somewhere I tell just anyone about, so you should consider yourself lucky I'm letting you in on it.
I'm looking forward to it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I'll do my best to live up to them,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: just like you've lived up to mine.
... Huh?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Let's head back.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Simulation complete.
